messages:
Amal: Quick sync — HW marketplace mini-pilot packaging & certification. Need to lock bundle artifact, reseller pricing tier, and compliance bits for Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant pilot. Who can own packaging + AM handoff?

Jordan: I can take packaging + CI for the bundle. Will need partner sample keys from HW side. @Maria can you confirm firmware signing requirements?

Maria: Firmware signing for the mini-appliance is unchanged — we need signed manifest + cert chain. Legal requires a short addendum for marketplace listing. cc @Sophia. :white_check_mark:

Sophia: Legal will draft addendum. ETA EOD Wed. Need to see reseller margin table to confirm language.

Liam: From marketplace ops: we need a 3MB signed manifest, a Docker image with tag `redwood/hw-edge:pilot-v1`, and a marketplace metadata YAML. Sample:
```
name: redwood-edge-mini
version: 0.1.0
components:
  - connector: snowflake-adapter:v1
  - connector: databricks-adapter:v1
  - vector: qdrant-sidecar:v0.9
signed: true
```
I'll add these to the checklist.

Jordan: Nice. I'll add CI job to build image + sign manifest. Need creds for Qdrant partner test cluster — @Amal can you share?

Amal: Sharing now via 1Password and emailing partner security. Also pinging provider: hw-partner@firmware.example for cert chain.

marketplace-bot: Checklist created: /workspace/marketplace/pilots/edge-mini/packaging-checklist

Maria: Quick note on EULA: partners want a "no-derivatives" clause for firmware. Legal prefers "no modification of signed firmware" — tradeoff? @Sophia

Sophia: We'll propose "no modification of signed firmware" in addendum to keep it enforceable.

Amal: Plan: Jordan owns packaging + CI; Sophia owns addendum; Maria owns certs; Liam owns marketplace metadata & listing draft. Next sync Friday 10AM PT. :calendar: 

Liam: Added calendar invite. I'll upload the draft YAML and sample image link before Thursday.

Jordan: Starting CI work now. Tagging branch: `marketplace/edge-mini-pack`.

Amal: Thanks everyone — if we hit blockers, drop notes here or DM me."
